text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: When the earth is quaked by its (final) quake.
text_1989: When the earth is severely quaked.
text_ref: When the earth is severely quaked.

text_1981: When the earth erupts and issues its loads. 3.
text_1989: And the earth ejects its loads.
text_ref: And the earth ejects its loads.

text_1981: The human will wonder: "What is happening?"
text_1989: The human will wonder: “What is happening?”
text_ref: The human will wonder: "What is happening?"

text_1981: On that day, it will explain.
text_1989: On that day, it will tell its news.
text_ref: On that day, it will tell its news.

text_1981: That the Lord had commanded it.
text_1989: That your Lord has commanded it.
text_ref: That your Lord has commanded it.

text_1981: On that day, the people will come out in throngs, to be shown their works.
text_1989: On that day, the people will issue from every direction, to be shown their works.
text_ref: On that day, the people will issue from every direction, to be shown their works.

text_1981: Whoever does an atom’s weight of righteousness will see it.
text_1989: Whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it.
text_ref: Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.

text_1981: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
text_1989: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it. . — \
text_ref: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
